name: edt-mcp-plagin
description: Local Codex plugin that installs EDT-MCP into 1C:EDT and ships a ready localhost MCP connection for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Installs EDT-MCP into local 1C EDT, patches the required JVM flag, and ships a ready localhost MCP connection so Codex can use EDT-MCP without editing global config files.
